text: The sound rule in business is that you may give money freely when you have a surplus, but your name never, neither as endorser nor as member of a corporation with individual liability. A trifling investment of a few thousand dollars, a mere trifle, yes, but a trifle possessed of deadly explosive power.
author: Andrew Carnegie
locator: Chapter XVI, Mills and the Men
location: Skibo Castle, Scotland and New York (presumed)
